verdict.rationale: Missive ships its own MCP server, so external assistants like Claude or ChatGPT can access and act on your conversations, contacts, calendar and drafts. The changelog explicitly suggests asking Claude to summarize your inbox, which covers the core of cross-inbox Q&A through an outside assistant. Missive also has a built-in assistant (sessions, your own API key), but the only documented Q&A for it is answering from Missive's help documentation, not searching your mail or calendar. Missing for 10: documented native assistant Q&A across the whole inbox and calendar, evidence of grounded or cited answers (who said what, what's outstanding), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers

citations.quote: External AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can now connect to Missive through the Model Context Protocol and act on your conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts, with the permissions you choose.
Ask Claude to summarize your inbox and draft replies without leaving the chat
official MCP server documented at https://missiveapp.com/docs/ai/mcp/server
